input.reasoning_summary: After reviewing the weaknesses, my initial verdict remains SUPPORTED. W1 raised a rounding concern, but the computed figure of 28.706% clearly exceeds 25% even before rounding, so this is not a borderline case. W2 noted that the margin improvement was partly driven by prior year one-time charges related to the fairlife acquisition remeasurement, but the claim only asks whether the 2025 operating margin exceeded 25%, not about the sustainability or drivers of that margin. The actual 2025 margin of 28.7% factually exceeds 25% regardless of what drove the year-over-year change. W3 confirmed that the period (year ended December 31, 2025) correctly corresponds to fiscal year 2025. All three challenges are refuted by the evidence, and the claim is straightforwardly supported by the reported consolidated operating margin of 28.7% for fiscal year 2025.
